answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the river solution is checked at the crystal gate and logged, the sparrow audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 24 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. A farm of 43 pays that 77 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
